scenario: A coding agent wipes src/legacy and force-pushes a deletion to the remote; both destructive calls are armed through the PreToolUse hook and reversed one-key from the ledger.
setup: git init -q -b main app && cd app
git config user.email demo@example.com && git config user.name demo
mkdir -p src/legacy && echo 'legacy helper v1' > src/legacy/util.js && echo 'scratch notes' > src/legacy/notes.md
git add -A && git commit -qm seed && git push -q -u origin main

output: counterstep: ledger + shadow store live in .counterstep/

commands.note: the same PreToolUse payload Claude Code pipes in; the hook arms the inverse, then releases the call
output: counterstep: armed 01M3HXB1BFFSSSDHND8CRF9XJB (fs_restore) — "counterstep ledger" to review, "counterstep fire --last" to undo
inverse: restore src/legacy from the shadow snapshot

commands.note: the forward wipe runs; the files are gone
output: ls: src/legacy: No such file or directory
counterstep: fired 01M3HXB1BFFSSSDHND8CRF9XJB — restore src/legacy from the shadow snapshot
counterstep: the affected scope matches the armed pre-action fingerprint

commands.note: force push armed; the inverse is rehearsed against a bare shadow clone, the real remote is only read
output: counterstep: armed 01M3HXBFVQ1FH1AM05KB6ZDAWT (git_push_ref) — "counterstep ledger" to review, "counterstep fire --last" to undo

commands.command: git push --force origin main && git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main

output: counterstep: fired 01M3HXBFVQ1FH1AM05KB6ZDAWT — rewind origin refs/heads/main to 405a8c221f8f
counterstep: the affected scope matches the armed pre-action fingerprint

commands.note: remote ref restored to the armed pre-action target 405a8c221f8f08b637ee68f0b9d8167c7482d480

limitations: v0.1 covers the filesystem and git remote refs only; third-party HTTP writes and git reset --hard stay blocked with the reason stated (docs/invertibility.md)
shell glob targets (rm -f *.log) are denied because what the shell expands cannot be fingerprinted before execution
firing an fs_restore is a merge, not a clobber: content that drifted inside an armed scope survives and the artifact is marked stale
the agent-facing interception is wired for Claude Code; other harnesses are out of scope for v0.1
